result.description:
Hi Team, I noticed an issue in Production related to duplicate management. The Standard Contact Duplicate Rule is intended to be bypassed for MuleSoft. Although the bypass was present, it was incorrectly updated during the 09/17 deployment with the UAT username. The username currently configured includes a “fulluat” suffix, which is not the actual MuleSoft integration user.

Due to this incorrect username, the bypass logic has not been functioning correctly and, It's blocking the trial lead creation in production.

Could you please take this up and update the duplicate rule with the correct MuleSoft integration username? This should just require a simple username correction. Let me know if you need any additional details.
